_doc: The box values the built-in button panel writes, by registry base (attribute = prefix + base): padding and radius per device, border width as one box of sides. tests/js/builtin-button-panel.test.js asserts the panel writes exactly these from its stand-in controls; tests/php/ButtonKitCssTest.php::test_the_values_the_panel_writes_print feeds them to sgs_button_kit_css, so a shape the panel writes and the PHP does not read fails one of the two.
